name: PaXini TORA DOUBLE ONE Model P
summary: A wheeled humanoid with tactile 18-DOF hands on an omnidirectional dual-steering chassis, rated 6.5 kg per arm, for logistics, industrial assistance and mobile manipulation indoors.

germany.statusNote: RBTX (igus, Germany) lists the Model P as its own article with price on request and a usual delivery time of 3 weeks.

notes: Tactile dexterous hands (18 DOF each) are part of the listed 56 DOF.
The maker says the two chassis (omnidirectional Model P, obstacle-crossing Model X) are swappable through a unified interface.
